whiteDisplayRootCause.reason: The vendored Tauri 2.11.5 crate's own doc comments explicitly document a Windows-specific deadlock in WebviewWindowBuilder::new/build when called from a synchronous #[tauri::command], citing https://github.com/tauri-apps/wry/issues/583. Both Tauri commands in this codebase that create the display window (display_presentation, open_presentation_display) were exactly that: plain synchronous commands. This is architecturally consistent with every piece of evidence gathered across Phases 3.8.3-3.8.4: Linux/WebKitGTK (which has no such deadlock) has rendered correctly in every Xvfb reproduction across both phases, while real Windows hardware has shown a blank/white display both times it was tested. A window frame can still be created by the OS while the WebView2 control inside it deadlocks before ever navigating, which produces exactly WebView2's own default white background - never the app's own CSS (which sets html,body to black unconditionally, but never gets a chance to run). The fix (converting both commands to async fn, per Tauri's own documented guidance) has not been confirmed by direct reproduction on real Windows/WebView2, since no such environment is accessible in this container.
